description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/blizzard/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccountConfirmationEmail" name="Account confirmation email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CharacterConfirmationAndSelfies" name="Character confirmation and selfies"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CharacterCreation" name="Start character creation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Set up account and think of names"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ThinkOfNames" name="Come up with character names"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" name="Have a Battle.net account?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmationEmail" name="Receive confirmation email" messageRef="Message_AccountConfirmationEmail"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the confirmation link"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccountMerge" name="Continue with Battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Active WoW subscription?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Choose payment method"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterBankInformation" name="Enter IBAN and BIC"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Continue after payment details"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge" name="Continue with subscription"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into the game"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select realm, race, and class"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin" name="Account setup and names ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter a character name"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check name availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation and character selfies">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CharacterConfirmation" messageRef="Message_CharacterConfirmationAndSelfies"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveExpansionReleaseMessage" name="Receive expansion release message">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ExpansionReleaseMessageReceived" name="Expansion release message received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Parallel" sourceRef="Start_CharacterCreation" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_To_ThinkNames" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_To_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNames_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfNames" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_To_AccountDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountDoesNotExist" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAccountInfo_To_ReceiveEmail" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveEmail_To_ClickLink" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationEmail" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_To_CheckSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSubscription_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionActive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">activeSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionInactive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not activeSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_To_MethodDecision" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentCreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "credit card"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentBankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterBankInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "bank account"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBankInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_To_SelectOptions" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectOptions_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharacterConfirmation_To_ExpansionMessage" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionReleaseMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionReleaseMessage" targetRef="End_ExpansionReleaseMessageReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
